name: Kitty Media
summary: Media Blasters' iconic North American licensing arm distributing uncensored classic and modern Japanese hentai OVAs on legal Blu-ray/DVD.
ranking_rationale: One of the longest-running legal physical hentai anime licensors outside Japan (trade-off: focused on physical discs & boutique licensing windows rather than instant streaming).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: One of the longest-running legal physical hentai anime licensors outside Japan
Uncensored official English sub & dub collector editions
cons: Focused on physical discs & boutique licensing windows rather than instant streaming
